price_wrong_names: SF Restaurant Week set menu: price '90' vs key '45'
problems_model: The main card is an SF Restaurant Week set menu; the wine pairing lines printed under each course are wine descriptions, not separate items. The price line '90 per person' and '45 optional wine pairing' are set-menu price lines (category other). The menu at top right (upside down, partly cut off at the top edge) is a separate menu and was not transcribed. Set-menu courses are shown as a set; no per-course prices are printed.
